metadata.audit_standard: Principal ML Infrastructure Engineer & Cloud Systems Architect

job_queue.engine: Redis 7.2 Cluster with AOF (Append-Only File) Persistence

transitions.submitted -> queued: Enqueued with priority score based on subscription tier
transitions.queued -> claimed: Worker claims with 30s visibility timeout and heartbeat lock
transitions.claimed -> processing: Inference worker begins SegFormer segmentation & mesh deformation
transitions.processing -> completed: GLB persisted to S3/GCS bucket; presigned asset URL generated
transitions.processing -> failed: Unrecoverable exception caught; retry counter incremented
transitions.failed -> queued: Retry attempt if retry_count < 3 with exponential backoff (2s, 8s, 32s)
transitions.failed -> dead_lettered: Exhausted 3 retries; moved to DLQ for engineer forensic analysis
transitions.* -> cancelled: User or timeout aborts processing cooperatively

idempotency_and_deduplication.behavior: Re-submitting duplicate payload returns existing completed job asset URL without re-computing inference

worker_heartbeat_and_reclamation.stale_worker_recovery: Orchestrator sweeps un-heartbeaten jobs and re-queues them automatically

durability_guarantees: Zero job loss on worker crash; persistent transaction log; state restored automatically upon pod resurrection
